publication_condition: The ten complete essays pass the independent full-prose/completeness gate. Apply or explicitly adjudicate the exact local meaning/scope/language/format suggestions before publication; no wholesale rewrite is required.
prose_assessment: Actually read all ten Spanish essays consecutively in source order, against the complete Chinese bodies already read during independent Korean authoring, rechecking the corresponding source paragraph on each flagged issue. This is complete reader prose, not outline-like compression: the contribution and control sides, objections, causes not established, competing remedies and open questions remain explicit. The essential local corrections concern emergency-care capacity, repayment arrangements, procompetitive benefits, contribution versus justification of unequal bidding, a missing fairness distinction and preserved uncertainty. Source metadata has a few genuine grammar/token-spacing faults.

post_application.actual_saved_prose_read: All 22 distinct affected full body units underlying the 23 exact suggestions, and all 15 distinct affected full metadata fields underlying the 16 suggestions, were retrieved from the saved Spanish file and actually reread, not assessed only by matching the replacement strings.
post_application.meaning_and_language: The saved corrections restore the intended meanings and remain natural in context. The facts versus allegation/settlement/implementation distinctions, approximate counts, dated cutoffs and open questions are intact. No new argument or historical assertion was introduced.
